Name: CUTSCENE_TIMEZONE_CONVERT_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the seven in-game time zones used by CutsceneGparamTimeParam and the hour shown in a cutscene for each. Only rows 0–6 are read, as zones 0 Morning, 1 Noon, 2 Afternoon, 3 Evening, 4 Night, 5 Deep Night A, 6 Deep Night B. A time outside every zone counts as Morning.

Fields.Name: Time Zone Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour at which this time zone starts (5.75 = 5:45). The zone runs until the next row's start hour (row 6 until row 0's) and may cross midnight. Retail: 5.75, 8.5, 12.5, 16.5, 19.5, 1.5, 3.

Fields.Name: Cutscene Hour
Fields.Description: Hour of day shown during a cutscene that uses this time zone (18 = 18:00). The world's time of day uses this hour while the cutscene plays; the in-game clock itself is not changed. Retail: 6.5, 10.5, 14.5, 18, 22.5, 2.25, 3.75.
